components.name: Modicon Trend Buffer Service

components.name: Modicon Control Execution Engine

components.name: Modicon I/O Scanner Module
components.description: 원격 I/O 및 필드 모듈과의 주기적 데이터 교환을 담당하는 스캐너 모듈.

components.name: Modbus/TCP Protocol Stack

components.name: EtherNet/IP CIP Stack

components.name: OPC UA Server Stack
components.description: OPC UA 주소공간, 구독, 보안 채널을 제공하는 서버 스택.

components.name: DNP3 Outstation Stack
components.description: DNP3 아웃스테이션 구현. 이벤트 클래스 폴링과 비요청 응답을 처리한다.

vulnerabilities.description: In CODESYS Gateway Server V2 for versions prior to V2.3.9.38 only a part of the the specified password is been compared to the real CODESYS Gateway password. An attacker may perform authentication by specifying a small password that matches the corresponding part of the longer real CODESYS Gateway password.

analysis.detail: Identified by SBOM component matching. VEX adjudication (exploitability in this ICS deployment) not yet performed.

vulnerabilities.description: A remote, authenticated attacker could utilize the control program of the CODESYS Control runtime system to use the vulnerability in order to read and modify the configuration file(s) of the affected products.

analysis.detail: Identified by SBOM component matching. VEX adjudication (exploitability in this ICS deployment) not yet performed.

vulnerabilities.description: Net-SNMP through 5.8 has Improper Privilege Management because SNMP WRITE access to the EXTEND MIB provides the ability to run arbitrary commands as root.

analysis.detail: Identified by SBOM component matching. VEX adjudication (exploitability in this ICS deployment) not yet performed.

vulnerabilities.description: An unauthenticated, remote attacker can disrupt existing communication channels between CODESYS products by guessing a valid channel ID and injecting packets. This results in the communication channel to be closed.

analysis.detail: Identified by SBOM component matching. VEX adjudication (exploitability in this ICS deployment) not yet performed.

vulnerabilities.description: _set_key in agent/helpers/table_container.c in Net-SNMP before 5.8 has a NULL Pointer Exception bug that can be used by an authenticated attacker to remotely cause the instance to crash via a crafted UDP packet, resulting in Denial of Service.

analysis.detail: Identified by SBOM component matching. VEX adjudication (exploitability in this ICS deployment) not yet performed.

vulnerabilities.description: net-snmp before 5.8.1.pre1 has a double free in usm_free_usmStateReference in snmplib/snmpusm.c via an SNMPv3 GetBulk request. NOTE: this affects net-snmp packages shipped to end users by multiple Linux distributions, but might not affect an upstream release.

analysis.detail: Identified by SBOM component matching. VEX adjudication (exploitability in this ICS deployment) not yet performed.

vulnerabilities.description: sf-pcapng.c in libpcap before 1.9.1 does not properly validate the PHB header length before allocating memory.

analysis.detail: Identified by SBOM component matching. VEX adjudication (exploitability in this ICS deployment) not yet performed.

vulnerabilities.description: In affected libpcap versions during the setup of a remote packet capture the internal function sock_initaddress() calls getaddrinfo() and possibly freeaddrinfo(), but does not clearly indicate to the caller function whether freeaddrinfo() still remains to be called after the function returns.  This makes it possible in some scenarios that both the function and its caller call freeaddrinfo() for the same allocated memory block.  A similar problem was reported in Apple libpcap, to which Apple assigned CVE-2023-40400.

analysis.detail: Identified by SBOM component matching. VEX adjudication (exploitability in this ICS deployment) not yet performed.
